items.context: At the Bitcoin Frontier (@thebtcfrontierX, 5.070 seguidores, en inglés): afirma que la fase de piso del ciclo está terminando, que estamos en la etapa final del mercado bajista y que viene un cambio de régimen en $BTC (dice que el 29 de junio predijo el piso). ~50 min, 2K vistas, 24 likes, 7 bookmarks y 10 respuestas: cuenta mediana con un post que despega, y se responde con datos del Drawdown Atlas sobre los tiempos de recuperación.
items.suggested_text:
Bottoms are the one call that can only be confirmed in hindsight, which is why thinking in phases beats anchoring on a single price. What history does show is that the end of a bear and the start of a recovery are not the same event.

In 2013 Bitcoin set two peaks months apart: one was reclaimed in 210 days, the other took 1,177. Same asset, same cycle, very different waits depending on where you entered. A regime change in trend can coexist with a long stretch of chop below the old high.

Maybe the more useful question isn't whether the $BTC bottom is in, but whether a position is built to survive the 1,177-day version of the story.
